full_details: Brooke stayed shut beside the roll. You were in the afternoon's comedy. Nick came on the whistle once. Augustine and John sent you home. The Rose is still dark, and nobody put a figure on it. Garnish still has the king. Six days run from yesterday, and you did not count his leaves. At home you kept the image of a hot lane and bucklers, and you did not give the serving-men their words. Anne's letter is still in the room. It names no day, and it has not gone.
one_sentence: You looked over the part at home, played Two Gentlemen at two, and came home by the same road.
title: Played Two Gentlemen
